headline: Timed Causeway Access and Seasonal Opening
reservation: During the winter, access is free to all visitors. Entry is strictly governed by tidal conditions as the island only opens when the causeway is clear. Visitors should verify daily tide times on the official website to ensure the path is navigable before attempting to cross.

days.title: Pilgrim Path and Art Gallery

stops.name: Steward's House Art Gallery
stops.detail: View the Sheila Hichens Collection featuring Newlyn School artists that depict 20th-century Cornish life.

days.driving: Allow 15 minutes for the walking crossing; conditions vary by tide
days.note: The ancient cobbled causeway is only exposed for approximately four hours each day.

intel.title: Tidal Crossing Safety
intel.text: Crossing the causeway outside of suggested times is hazardous due to strong currents and rapidly rising sea levels. The path is uneven and cobbled, requiring careful footing and a check of accessibility info.

intel.title: Winter Operations
intel.text: The island, including shops and the art gallery, operates on a seasonal schedule. Check the official site for specific winter opening hours which depend entirely on the daily tide window.
